short_bio: American novelist known for horror and suspense fiction, author of Carrie, The Shining and It.
biography:
Stephen King was born in Portland, Maine, and studied at the University of Maine. His first published novel, Carrie, appeared in 1974, and The Shining (1977) and The Stand (1978) followed.

He wrote It (1986) and Misery (1987), and published several novels as Richard Bachman. On Writing (2000) is part memoir, part guide to the craft.

The Mystery Writers of America made him a Grand Master in 2007 and he received the National Medal of Arts in 2014. Many of his books have been adapted for film and television.
